nfl_2026_11_TEN_DAL.summary: Tennessee hopes to have rookie receiver Carnell Tate back from a shoulder injury after two missed games; he was limited again Thursday. Dallas is without tight end Jake Ferguson, out for multiple weeks with a knee sprain, with Luke Schoonmaker filling in.
